instruction: Move the image on Page 2 to the right side of the slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the picture on Page 2 (slide index 1) to the right side of the slide. Slide width is 9144000 EMUs. For the picture to be considered 'on the right', its left position should be at least 5000000 EMUs (approximately 55% across the slide from left). This allows room for the picture width while ensuring it's clearly positioned on the right side.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: checks if picture on Page 2 is positioned on the right side of the slide
Getter extracts picture position from correct slide (slide_index=1 corresponds to Page 2)
Metric logic is semantically correct: compares picture's left coordinate against threshold (5000000 EMUs ~55% across slide)
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification using Ctrl+S
Expected value (min_left=5000000) is reasonable for 'right side' given slide width of 9144000 EMUs
Data flow is correct: getter extracts position -> metric compares left coordinate -> returns 1.0 if on right, 0.0 otherwise
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter only finds the first picture on the slide. If multiple pictures exist, it may not verify the intended image. Consider adding logic to handle multiple pictures or verify there's only one picture on the slide.
Minor: The threshold of 5000000 EMUs (55%) is somewhat arbitrary. Consider using a more standard threshold like 50% (4572000) or documenting why 55% was chosen for 'right side' positioning.
